notes.title: Happy New Year!!!
notes.notes:
Hello guys :D
Long time no see.

We already in the last day of 2018. And it's been a year for Legion Tale. Many things happened in 2018 but we learned a lot of things too. Legion Tale is our first tactical turn-based game. But we still have lot of things to do to make it better. We realize that if we want to be better on making a game, we need all of you guys. 

We need all of your feedback, suggestion, your thought, and anything like that about our game so we can be better in the next development. That's why we need your honest review about our game. So please tell us everything in your mind about our game, about Legion Tale, on review section and we'll learn from it. We'll try our best to be better so you guys will enjoy playing our game.

Right now, we are developing a simulation game called "Age of Hydroponics" and "Aquaculture Land". 

For Age of Hydroponics, it's a hydroponics farm simulation game where you manage your farm business in an urban area. And for Aquaculture Land, Aquaculture Land is an aquafarming simulation game. In this game, you will act as a businessman that runs a freshwater fish farm. You will manage all things related to fisheries.

For Age of Hydroponics, because we still don't have steam store page for it, you can follow our Twitter account : https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames for the newest update about the development. Here some sneak peek from Age of Hydroponics :
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/c3844cd457385aacee700e4f65fbcbc41c029c57.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/8dc9440a26e4f650b656b2f8101dc8b407ca1074.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/7c7c002f2f62ddd3a3cd9f509fa48aa30cf69206.png[/img]

For Aquaculture Land, because we already have steam store page for it, you can check it here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/
You can wishlist it so will know when we post some new update about it. Here some sneak peek from Aquaculture Land :
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/2b162c5580f316943ac2cd38b79f4d5103674585.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/90becb56a9cc72603d4706e36c187ef68dd865f9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/0d0e67feaaffff0ceb396ff4123b1b649560d706.gif[/img]

We hope we'll get better and better in 2019. We hope we can make our new games good enough to make all of you guys enjoy playing it. Thanks for all of your support so far. And please, keep supporting us from now on.

Happy new year guys :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27997093/540f224c424125df2e4c96432fa3cc431e05f3dd.gif[/img]

notes.title: [Update v1.0.4] Performance and Balancing!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30392533/fa0362dc1b016c793d548277fd48f0dbde3f5a81.png[/img]

Hello guys,

First of all we want to say thank you for playing Legion Tale. We really appreciate all of your feedbacks. Your reviews and feedbacks will always make our games better.

After we fixed the translation issue, we focused on performance issue and balancing. With this new update, we already made some performance improvement that fixed some lagginess on the gameplay. We also did some balancing on stage 9, 15, and 23. We tried to make the stages more challenging instead of frustrating.

You can check the version of the game on the bottom right of title screen. If the version written is v1.0.4, then your game has already updated.

We hope with this new update, you guys will feel more enjoy to play Legion Tale.

Don't forget to give us some feedbacks or reviews about the game.

Cheers!

notes.title: TRANSLATION UPDATE! V1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30392533/bc1e81a679ae489873729383f2e9de05199b1b05.jpg[/img]

Dear players, 

We are grateful of all your feedbacks and have taken each one of them into consideration. Updates will take some time, but we can assure you that we’ve been working hard to get it done as fast as possible. Thank you for being patience and still sticking with us. 

One of the main issue players seem to be having with Legion Tale is the bad translation in the game’s story and we’re here to announce that it will no longer be an issue! 

With this new update, we have fixed the dialogues, stories and all story related components within the games that previously have bad translation issue. They’re all have been proofread and hope this would enhance players’ experience with Legion Tale. 

You can check on the title screen (on the bottom right of the screen) there is version for this new update, and the version is V1.0.2.

We hope that this update will help players to enjoy Legion Tale even more.

Thank you for your support and feedbacks to make this a better game!
